findings.text: The warm-roadmap timing and cProfile attribution the section's Done-when paragraph and the coordinator's note require (base and head warm roadmap on the fleet node, plus a warm crew(view="runs") timing) were not obtained: no base arm of reckon.mcp._roadmap(project="reckon") returned, its log closing EXIT=143 after repeated 10 s Git history/last-modified timeouts against the shared main checkout. The section's own test measure (each covered directory's identity checked at most once) is met and recorded, but the read-time reduction the section exists to demonstrate is unmeasured, and the residual attribution the following section takes as input is absent. Promote on the mechanics; a separate quiet-window node must still run the timing clause.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The production call sites are reckon/mcp.py:1950 and :1829, reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1532, reckon/serve.py:1418/1422, and the three metadata_index readers at :404, :497 and :788; none is a test file.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 22e519727493: two commits, 4975079ad (perf: join the region, add covered_dir_identity, enter the scope in mcp._roadmap) and 0f04bf6de (docs: the landing fragment); no second context manager, no change to serve.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_warm_read_revalidates_once.py holding two clauses; that file's tests at lines 179 and 192 assert max_per_directory <= 1 and a 12->13 plan count across two calls, and the manifest records the run (gate-head.log 49 passed / 1 failed).
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal (plan a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline s46) is that one read checks each covered directory's identity at most once; reckon/metadata_index.py:168 adds covered_dir_identity, which returns the first identity observed inside discovery_file_scope, and the three readers at lines 404, 497 and 788 now go through it.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states gate-head.log and gate-base.log results (1 pre-existing failure, test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window, at both arms), a negative_control_log path, and a follow_ons note that the fleet-node timing did not complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Declared write paths were reckon/metadata_index.py, reckon/serve.py, reckon/mcp.py and tests/test_a_warm_read_revalidates_once.py; every source path in the diff (reckon/metadata_index.py, reckon/mcp.py, the new test, the evidence fragment) is inside them and reckon/serve.py was correctly left unchanged.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_warm_read_revalidates_once.py:189 fails on the reinstated regression: the negative-control run (logs/negative-control.log) restores the replacing scope and the count returns to 3, reddening that id while the head arm passes it.
justifications.evidence: The gate at logs/gate-head.log asserts the identity count via tests/test_a_warm_read_revalidates_once.py:189, but the timing/profile clause of the section's Done-when paragraph is unrecorded (docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-warm-read-revalidates-once.html:58).
justifications.fit: reckon/metadata_index.py:168 mirrors the existing covered_stat idiom and the surrounding region docstrings, and both commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no plan or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/metadata_index.py:168-188 makes one warm read observe each covered directory once, reducing the counted identity checks from 3 to 1 per directory (logs/dircheck-counts-head.txt).
justifications.reuse: covered_dir_identity extends the module's own _dir_identity (reckon/metadata_index.py:794) and reuses the region established by discovery_file_scope, adding no forked capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the diff (reckon/metadata_index.py, reckon/mcp.py, the new test, the evidence fragment) is inside the declared write paths, and reckon/serve.py needed no change.
